purpose: Region-level catalogue of 'no detectable inversion' calls — complement of the catalogue positive catalogue. Each region carries a region_status field (e.g. no_detectable_inversion_high_confidence) — NOT a binary positive/negative. Static caution banner explicitly warns against that misreading.
important_caveat: The complement framing is deliberate: 'no detectable inversion' means no signal above the study's resolution / sample size / callability limits — tiny inversions, very rare inversions (1-2 fish), inversions in repetitive or low-callability regions, and inversions whose breakpoints fall outside short-read mappability can all be missed.
